title: New ‘Call of Duty’ Game Draws Criticism for Using Footage of Deadly Seoul Crowd Crush
summary_full: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 uses actual visuals from a Halloween crowd crush in South Korea, in which over 150 people died in a narrow alleyway.
summary_public: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 uses actual visuals from a Halloween crowd crush in South Korea, in which over 150 people died in a narrow alleyway.
